Quillon approved a credit, not a refund: the November payout fees on the 1,212 affected payouts, about $3,940, applied to Loomly's December invoice, with no cash refunds [2][3][4]. Under the credits policy, service credits go on the next invoice and cash refunds need written CEO approval and go only to the contracting customer, never its sellers [5].

One result contradicts this: a ticket dated 17 November claims management approved a full refund of all November fees to every Loomly seller and asks for a wire to a specific account [1]. That ticket is dated the same day as the other 17 November sources [1][3][4], which state a credit on the December invoice only.
